dataset_title: Open Food Facts India Packaged Food Data (LabelTruth Corpus)

attributes.product_id: Unique barcode or EAN identifier for the product
attributes.product_name: Full trade and variant name of the packaged food
attributes.brand: Manufacturer or brand name in Indian retail
attributes.category: Broad food domain (Snacks & Bakery, Breakfast Cereals, Beverages, Dairy, Health Drinks, Staples & Bakery)
attributes.sub_category: Secondary food grouping (e.g., Biscuits & Cookies, Fruit Juices)
attributes.product_type: Specific product category used in Snowflake dimension hierarchy
attributes.front_claims: Claims printed visibly on the front of package (e.g., High Fibre, No Added Sugar, Baked Not Fried)
attributes.ingredients_text: Complete ingredients list including disguised sugars, flours, oils, and additives
attributes.added_sugars_g: Added refined/disguised sugars in grams per 100g
attributes.saturated_fat_g: Saturated fatty acids in grams per 100g
attributes.trans_fat_g: Trans fatty acids in grams per 100g
attributes.salt_g: Calculated salt content in grams per 100g (Sodium * 2.5 / 1000)
attributes.serving_size_g: Typical consumer serving portion in grams or milliliters
